title: The Rust core fell behind the Mac
area: Rust port of a Swift change, conformance
source: #88 merged, with its Rust half taken out. The base commit 598ec36d is made locally and kept as refs/bench/f88-base: the tree of 1ab4af81 with core/ramble-text/src/clean.rs from 1ab4af81^ (git read-tree 1ab4af81; git update-index --cacheinfo 100644,$(git rev-parse 1ab4af81^:core/ramble-text/src/clean.rs),core/ramble-text/src/clean.rs; git commit-tree $(git write-tree) -p 1ab4af81 -m 'bench: #88 with the Rust half taken out (follow task base)'), That gives the same tree; the commit id differs by author and date, so set `base` to the commit made.
authored_tests: The repository's own conformance test is the grader: the fixtures are recordings of the Swift pipeline, and the Rust port must reproduce them. The grader restores the test, corpus and fixtures from the reference before it runs.
check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -p ramble-core -p ramble-text --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && swift build --package-path core/conformance/generator && core/conformance/generator/.build/debug/GenerateFixtures core/conformance/corpus-text.json core/conformance/fixtures/text/pipeline.json && git diff --quiet -- core/conformance/fixtures && ./scripts/check-network-surface.sh
